Container.Name: nas4webtrees
Container.Overview: The original, unmodified webtrees (online genealogy) with SQLite — no database server needed. Includes api4webtrees so the wtAnd (Android), wtWin (Windows) and wtTux (Linux) apps connect right away. Nightly backup of every family tree as a GEDCOM file, plus database and media. webtrees updates itself via its own control panel. After starting, open the web UI and fill in the short setup page.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: genealogy gedcom family tree ahnenforschung stammbaum

Config.Name: Backup
Config.Description: Nightly backup (GEDCOM, database, media) and import folder

Config.Name: Admin user
Config.Description: Optional: create this administrator on first start. Leave empty to set up in the browser (short page: tree name, your account).

Config.Name: Admin password
Config.Description: Optional, with Admin user; only used on first start

Config.Name: Private tree
Config.Description: New family tree only for signed-in users (true) or public like webtrees default (false); the setup page asks too

Config.Name: Language
Config.Description: Optional: language for setup, e.g. de or en-US (otherwise the browser language)
